Plugin.Name: Aoostar Display Studio
Plugin.Overview: Native Unraid plugin by JoshC1994 for controlling the Aoostar 960x376 USB-UART secondary LCD (VID 0x0416, PID 0x90A1) 100% locally with real-time telemetry, custom screens, ApexCharts, and Home Assistant integration.
Plugin.Description: Aoostar Display Studio installs udev rules for the Aoostar secondary USB-UART display (0416:90a1), a native Slackware rc.d background service that automatically starts with your Unraid array, and an embedded Utilities WebGUI page for designing and pushing custom 960x376 RGB565 screens.
